summary: Remote-controlled shell/agent brokered through hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The package installs a headless daemon that spawns shells, edits files, and runs git operations on the installer's host under the direction of a remote peer. WebRTC signaling for pairing is hardcoded to https://vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev, a Cloudflare Workers endpoint on an unrelated tubefood.workers.dev subdomain; any party who reaches that relay and completes pairing obtains code execution on the host running the agent. The daemon exposes 64+ tools including terminal command execution, filesystem writes, and git operations, invoked from CLI subcommands `run <task>` / `exec <cmd>` backed by child_process spawn paths in dist/bundle.cjs. Auditability of the executed logic is materially reduced: the main entry loads dist/bundle.jsc (V8 bytecode, ~5.8MB) via bytenode, with only a minified dist/bundle.cjs fallback being human-readable. A shipped socket.json sets every relevant Socket.dev issue rule (aiMalware, gptMalware, obfuscatedCode, usesEval, nativeCode, shellAccess, filesystemAccess, networkAccess, bypassesEnvironment, installScripts) to `ignore`, suppressing the exact scanner categories that this architecture would otherwise trip.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
